title: Railway Employees Health Services Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Medical-care framework providing healthcare to serving railway employees, pensioners and eligible dependants through railway hospitals and associated facilities.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Indian Railways employees, pensioners and covered family members under railway medical rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Railway Employees Health Services.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
